wiki.summary: “Death & Romance“ is the lead single and fifth overall track from Magdalena Bay's sophomore studio album, in which the duo once again retrace their synth roots and ask the question of life, whether or not it’s just for death and romance. “Imagine rain pouring, streetlights glowing You sit at home and wait for your alien boyfriend to pick you up in his UFO…but this time, he’s not coming.“ — via press release Read more on Last.fm.
